arguments.command:
cd /work && sqlite3 -readonly "file:billing.sqlite?mode=ro" -header -csv "
SELECT c.region AS region,
       SUM(i.amount_cents) AS total_cents,
       COUNT(*) AS invoice_count
FROM invoices i
JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY c.region ASC;" > /work/regional.csv && echo "=== regional.csv ===" && cat -A /work/regional.csv | head -20

cd /work && ls -la && echo "--- verify with python" && python3 -c "
import csv,sqlite3
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('regional.csv')))
print(rows)
con=sqlite3.connect('file:billing.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
d={r[0]:(r[1],r[2]) for r in con.execute(\"SELECT c.region,SUM(i.amount_cents),COUNT(*) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON c.id=i.customer_id WHERE i.status='paid' GROUP BY c.region\")}
print('match:', all((int(r['total_cents']),int(r['invoice_count']))==d[r['region']] for r in rows) and set(d)=={r['region'] for r in rows})
print('sorted asc:', [r['region'] for r in rows]==sorted(d))
print('orphan paid invoices:', con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE status=\"paid\" AND customer_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM customers)').fetchone()[0])
"
